title: Business Process Designer
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Business Process Designer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyzes, develops, and improves workflows. Identifies inefficiencies in existing processes and proposes solutions to optimize effectiveness. Collaborates with business users to identify and define detailed product requirements and use cases. Design continuous monitoring and feedback collection to help them refine processes over time.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Business Process Designer, you will engage in a dynamic environment where your primary focus will be on analyzing, developing, and enhancing workflows. A typical day involves collaborating with various business users to identify inefficiencies in existing processes, proposing innovative solutions to optimize effectiveness, and designing continuous monitoring systems to refine processes over time. Your role will require you to gather detailed product requirements and use cases, ensuring that the workflows align with the overall business objectives and contribute to improved operational efficiency.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be a Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have influencing and advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather insights and feedback from stakeholders.
* Develop comprehensive documentation to support process improvements and ensure clarity across teams.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and improve business processes.
* Experience in workflow design and optimization techniques.
* Ability to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies to ensure timely delivery of solutions.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Web Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Goranggo Solutions Pvt Ltd is a dynamic IT services company focused on innovative digital transformation solutions for businesses of all sizes. The organization leverages cutting\-edge technologies to improve efficiency, streamline operations, and support sustainable growth for its clients. With strong expertise in cloud computing, enterprise software, IT consulting, and data analytics, Goranggo Solutions delivers tailored solutions that address complex business challenges. Team members collaborate in a technology\-driven environment that values problem\-solving, customer success, and continuous learning in the digital age.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Web Designer will work full time on\-site in Kolkata, creating visually appealing, user\-friendly websites and digital interfaces that align with client requirements and brand guidelines. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include designing web layouts, graphics, and UI elements; collaborating with developers and content teams; and ensuring that designs are consistent, accessible, and optimized for performance. * Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator or similar).

* Relevant academic background in Design, Computer Science, Multimedia, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in an IT services or digital agency environment is an advantage.

title: Product Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and trend\-driven Product Designer to help shape Nestasia's product portfolio. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, a passion for discovering trends, and the ability to conceptualise products that are aesthetically appealing and commercially relevant.
 



  





**Duties and responsibilities** 




  




* Benchmark leading global and Indian lifestyle brands to identify emerging design and product trends.
* Translate market insights and customer feedback into new product ideas and collection concepts.
* Review product samples and provide design inputs to enhance aesthetics, functionality and overall customer appeal.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to ensure the final product aligns with the original design intent.
* Contribute to seasonal launches by developing cohesive product stories and design themes.
* Build and maintain a library of design inspirations, materials, finishes and trend forecasts.
* Explore opportunities for product innovation while balancing creativity, functionality and commercial viability.
* Present design concepts, mood boards and new collection ideas to internal stakeholders.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  




* 3–6 years of experience in Product Design, Product Development or Lifestyle Design.
* Experience with home décor, lifestyle, fashion, gifting or consumer brands is preferred.
* Strong understanding of design trends, colour, materials and product aesthetics.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and/or relevant design software.
* Excellent visualisation, creative thinking and communication skills.
* A strong portfolio showcasing original product concepts and collections is essential.
* Preferably from design college \-
 **NID/NIFT.**

title: Senior Interior Designer
description:
Senior Interior Designer \| Residential Interiors \| End\-to\-End Project Ownership
 
  





 📍 New Town, Kolkata
 



 💰 Up to ₹9 LPA \+ Performance Incentives
 



 🎯 Experience: 3\+ years in Residential Interior Design
 



 🗓️ 6 Days a Week \| Full\-time \| In\-office
 



 🏢 FABDIZ Interior Design \& Architecture
 



  




 This is not a drawing\-only Interior Designer role.
 
 At FABDIZ, once a signed residential project is assigned to you, you become the
 **primary design owner** 
 from client brief to project handover.
 



 You will meet the client, understand the brief, develop the design, present your ideas, coordinate BOQ and materials, work with production and execution teams, visit sites and solve design challenges until the final home is delivered.
 



**You design it.** 




**You own it.** 




**You see it come alive.** 




  




 What You Will Own
 
 Your journey will typically look like:
 



**Client Brief → Concept → Space Planning → 3D Design → Client Presentation → Design Finalisation → BOQ Coordination → Production Coordination → Site Execution → Handover** 




**Your core responsibilities will include:** 




**• Design premium residential apartments, villas and turnkey homes** 




**• Develop space plans, furniture layouts, mood boards and material palettes** 




**• Design modular kitchens, wardrobes, furniture, lighting and décor elements** 




**• Create 3D visualisations and detailed working drawings** 




**• Present designs directly to homeowners and handle design discussions** 




**• Coordinate with Sales, Project Managers, Site Engineers, Production, Vendors and Installation Teams** 




**• Conduct site visits and resolve design and execution challenges** 




**• Protect the approved design intent from concept through execution** 




**• Understand BOQs, materials, specifications, scope changes and cost implications** 




  




 What Makes This Role Different?
 
 You will not simply receive a brief, prepare drawings and pass the project to someone else.
 



 You will have meaningful ownership of the design journey.
 



 We expect you to ask:
 



**Can this layout work better?** 




**Can the storage be smarter?** 




**Can we improve the client's experience?** 




**Can this design be executed more efficiently?** 




**Can we create something distinctive without compromising functionality or budget?** 




**At FABDIZ, independent design thinking is encouraged and ownership is expected.** 




  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for a Senior Interior Designer who can operate independently, think creatively and communicate confidently with clients.
 



**Must have:** 




**• 3\+ years of relevant Residential Interior Design experience** 




**• Strong exposure to turnkey residential projects** 




**• Hands\-on experience from design development through execution** 




**• Strong client consultation and presentation skills** 




**• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp and Enscape** 




**• Good understanding of modular kitchens and wardrobes** 




**• Practical knowledge of BOQs, materials and interior execution** 




**• Strong site coordination capability** 




**• Ability to manage projects independently** 




**• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills** 




  




 Your Portfolio Matters More Than Your Job Title
 
 Your CV tells us where you worked.
 



**Your portfolio tells us how you think.** 




**We want to see:** 




**• Residential projects you personally designed** 




**• Space planning and furniture layouts** 




**• 3D visualisations** 




**• Modular kitchens and wardrobes** 




**• Material and finish selections** 




**• Client presentations** 




**• Turnkey projects** 




**• Executed projects, wherever available** 




**During the discussion, be prepared to explain what you personally designed, what decisions you made and how involved you were during execution.** 




  




 The FABDIZ Ecosystem
 
 Designers work within an integrated project ecosystem connecting:
 



**Design → Production → Installation → Handover** 




**FABDIZ has centralised modular manufacturing support in Bangalore, along with Kolkata\-based installation and execution capabilities.** 




**This means you are not designing in isolation. You are working within a system built to take residential designs from concept to completion.** 




  




 Growth
 
 High\-performing designers can grow toward:
 



**Senior Interior Designer → Design Lead → Design Manager → City/Regional Design Leadership** 




  




 This Role Will Suit You If...
 
 You want to move from
 **executing instructions** 
 to
 **owning design decisions** 
 .
 



 You enjoy working directly with homeowners.
 



 You like solving real design and execution problems.
 



 You want to see your designs become completed homes.
 



 And you are comfortable being accountable for the outcome, not just the drawing.
 



  




 Apply / DM
 
 Please apply with your
 **updated CV \+ portfolio** 
 .
 



**Important:** 
 LinkedIn may stop accepting applications once the job reaches its application limit.
 



**When the application limit is reached, do not assume the opportunity is closed. DM me directly with:** 




**“FABDIZ DESIGNER” \+ Your CV \+ Portfolio** 




**Relevant profiles will be reviewed for the next stage of hiring.** 




**Location:** 
 RDB Primarc Tech Park, New Town, Kolkata
 



**Salary:** 
 Up to ₹9 LPA \+ Performance Incentives
 



**Experience:** 
 3\+ years \| Residential Interiors
 



**Work Schedule:** 
 6 days a week \| In\-office
 



  





**FABDIZ is looking for designers who don't just create beautiful spaces.** 




**We are looking for designers who are ready to own them.**

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Location:** 

 Kolkata, West Bengal
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time, On\-site
 




**Experience Required:** 

 3\-4 years minimum
 




  




**About the Role** 

  






 We are looking for a skilled and creative Graphic Designer to join our team in Kolkata. You will handle print and packaging design, photo manipulation, and digital marketing creatives, while leading a small team of 2\-3 designers. The ideal candidate combines strong design fundamentals with efficient, AI\-assisted workflows.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

  




* Design print collateral and packaging (brochures, labels, boxes, catalogues, standees, etc.) that is print\-ready and production\-accurate.
* Perform advanced photo editing, retouching, and manipulation for product, campaign, and marketing use.
* Create digital marketing designs for social media, ads, email campaigns, website banners, and other platforms.
* Edit and produce short videos, reels, and promotional content.
* Use AI tools in your daily workflow to speed up ideation, production, and enhancement while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, and production teams to understand briefs and deliver on deadlines.
* Maintain brand guidelines and ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
* Manage multiple projects at once and handle client or internal feedback and revisions.



  




**Required Skills** 

  





**Design and Editing Software** 




  




* Adobe Photoshop (advanced)
* Adobe Illustrator (advanced)
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe Lightroom
* Wondershare Filmora



  





**Other Skills** 




  




* Hands\-on experience with AI tools (e.g., for image generation, enhancement, copy or content support) as part of daily work
* Strong understanding of print production, dielines, colour modes (CMYK/RGB), and packaging formats
* Sound knowledge of typography, layout, colour theory, and composition
* Ability to lead a team, give constructive feedback, and manage workflow



  




**Qualifications and Experience** 

  




* Minimum 3\-4 years of relevant experience in graphic design
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a team of at least 2\-3 people
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Fine Arts, or a related field (preferred)
* A strong portfolio showcasing print, packaging, photo manipulation, and digital work (mandatory)

description:
**Job Description** 




**Motion Graphics \& Product CGI Designer** 




**Department:** 
 Marketing \- Creative \& Design
 



**Location:** 
 Baidyanath Head Office, Kolkata
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**About the Role** 




 Baidyanath is looking for an experienced and creatively driven
 **Motion Graphics \& Product CGI Designer** 
 to develop premium, engaging and commercially effective visual content for Baidyanath and Goodcare.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **motion graphics, video editing, product animation and 3D/CGI visualisation** 
 , with a proven ability to transform marketing briefs into high\-quality, publish\-ready creative assets.
 



 This role requires someone who can independently conceptualise and execute product\-led reels, digital advertisements, educational videos, CGI product films and e\-commerce content. The candidate should combine technical expertise with strong visual aesthetics, storytelling and an understanding of marketing objectives.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional who can take complete ownership of creative execution, maintain a premium visual standard and deliver projects with minimal supervision.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Motion Graphics \& Product Video Creation** 



* Conceptualise and create premium product\-led reels, animated advertisements, product launch videos and promotional content.
* Develop engaging motion graphics, kinetic typography, product reveals and ingredient animations.
* Translate product features and approved USPs into visually compelling stories.
* Create educational explainers, product\-benefit videos, demonstrations and brand\-led content.
* Develop attention\-grabbing opening hooks, engaging transitions, clear messaging and effective calls to action.
* Independently manage projects from storyboard and concept development through to final delivery.



**2\. Video Editing \& Post\-Production** 



* Edit doctor\-led videos, nutritionist explainers, influencer content, user\-generated content (UGC), testimonials and product demonstrations.
* Transform raw footage into high\-quality short\-form content through effective storytelling, pacing, transitions, captions and sound design.
* Perform compositing, colour correction, masking, retouching, clean\-up and final finishing.
* Integrate motion graphics, product renders and CGI elements into live\-action footage.
* Ensure all videos are polished, on\-brand and ready for publication.



**3\. Product CGI \& 3D Visualisation** 



* Create realistic 3D product renders and animations for bottles, jars, cartons, tubes, capsules and other FMCG and wellness products.
* Develop premium hero shots, product rotations, close\-ups, ingredient interactions and cinematic product reveals.
* Create realistic materials, lighting, shadows, reflections, textures and visual compositions.
* Accurately reproduce product shapes, packaging, labels, colours and proportions using approved artwork and references.
* Develop CGI concepts that enhance product storytelling and go beyond conventional product photography.
* Build reusable 3D assets for campaigns, digital advertising and e\-commerce content.



**4\. Performance Marketing \& Social Media Creatives** 



* Create high\-impact video advertisements for Meta, Instagram, YouTube and other digital platforms.
* Develop creative concepts that capture attention within the first three seconds.
* Produce multiple creative variations using different hooks, messaging, product presentations and CTAs for testing.
* Adapt master creatives into different durations, aspect ratios and platform\-specific formats.
* Collaborate with the performance marketing team to refine creative assets based on campaign feedback and performance insights.



**5\. E\-commerce, Marketplace \& D2C Content** 



* Develop product videos, ingredient animations, benefit explainers and demonstration videos for Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces.
* Create video assets for D2C product detail pages (PDPs), product listings and brand stores.
* Produce platform\-specific creatives for quick\-commerce channels such as Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart.
* Ensure product communication is clear, visually appealing and aligned with marketplace specifications.
* Develop adaptations across SKUs, pack sizes and product variants while maintaining consistency.



**6\. Static Creative \& Product Design Support** 



* Convert CGI renders and video assets into premium static product creatives.
* Support the design team with product compositions, ingredient visuals, e\-commerce listing images, infographics and campaign adaptations.
* Maintain consistency in typography, colour, visual hierarchy, packaging accuracy and brand identity.



*Static design will be a supporting responsibility. The primary focus of this role will remain motion graphics, video production and product CGI.* 




**7\. Creative Ownership \& Collaboration** 



* Translate marketing briefs into original concepts, visual treatments, mood boards and storyboards.
* Explore creative ways to communicate Ayurveda, wellness, ingredients and product stories through a modern, premium visual language.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, design, e\-commerce and performance marketing teams.
* Take ownership of creative quality, timelines, revisions and final delivery.
* Maintain organised project files, editable working files and reusable creative assets.
* Ensure product packaging and on\-screen benefit claims match approved brand and product information.



**Required Technical Skills** 




**Essential** 



* **Adobe After Effects:** 
 Advanced motion graphics, animation, compositing and visual effects.
* **Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve:** 
 Professional video editing and post\-production.
* **Adobe Photoshop:** 
 Advanced image editing, manipulation and compositing.
* **Blender or Cinema 4D:** 
 Strong working knowledge of 3D product modelling, texturing, lighting, rendering and animation.



**Preferred** 



* Adobe Illustrator.
* Substance 3D Painter or Designer.
* Redshift, Octane, V\-Ray, Cycles or equivalent rendering engines.
* Houdini or other tools for advanced simulations.
* AI\-assisted creative tools and workflows.



*Candidates are not required to master every software listed. The ability to independently deliver high\-quality creative work is more important than proficiency in a large number of tools.* 




**Candidate Profile** 



* **6\-8 years of relevant professional experience** 
 in motion graphics, video production, product visualisation, CGI or related creative roles.
* Proven experience delivering complete product\-led videos and digital advertisements.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography, colour and premium product aesthetics.
* Excellent knowledge of lighting, materials, reflections, shadows and realistic product presentation.
* Ability to balance creative innovation with brand consistency and marketing objectives.
* Strong understanding of social media, performance advertising and e\-commerce content requirements.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly with packaging, labels, logos, product proportions and approved claims.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and deliver within timelines.
* Strong creative problem\-solving skills and the ability to guide projects from concept to final output.



**Preferred Industry Experience** 




 Experience working with FMCG, beauty, skincare, wellness, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, Ayurveda or other consumer product brands will be an advantage.
 



 Candidates from creative agencies, production studios or digital\-first consumer brands with strong product\-video portfolios are also welcome.
 



  





**Mandatory Portfolio Requirements** 




**A portfolio and video showreel must be submitted along with the CV.** 




 The portfolio should demonstrate:
 


1. At least two complete product\-led reels or digital advertisements.
2. High\-quality motion graphics and product animations.
3. At least one edited UGC, influencer, expert\-led or product\-demonstration video.
4. Photorealistic 3D product renders or CGI animations demonstrating lighting, materials and packaging accuracy.
5. E\-commerce product videos or product\-benefit explainers.
6. Original creative concepts demonstrating premium aesthetics and strong visual impact.

title: Junior Designer
description:
Junior Designer @ Shizz
 



**0–2 years \| Full\-time \| Kolkata** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who makes things look 👌
 



 Shizz is a digital agency working with brands across D2C, FMCG, beauty, food, lifestyle and everything in between.
 



 We’re looking for a 
 **Junior Designer** 
  who gets excited about good design, has an unhealthy amount of Pinterest/Instagram saved posts and can turn a random brief into something people actually want to look at.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 



* Designing 
 **social media posts, carousels, stories \& ads** 
  that don't look like every other brand on Instagram.
* Turning creative ideas into scroll\-stopping visuals.
* Working on 
 **campaigns, launches, brand identities and digital content** 
 .
* Taking one design and making it work across 17 different formats because Instagram apparently needs that.
* Creating pitch decks and presentations that clients actually enjoy looking at.
* Working closely with our 
 **creative, strategy, copy and account teams** 
 .
* Bringing references, ideas, trends and "wait, hear me out..." concepts to the table.
* Taking feedback, making changes, questioning feedback occasionally, and making the work better.
* Keeping an eye on what's happening in 
 **design, advertising, culture and the internet** 
 .



  





**You should probably apply if...** 



* You have 
 **0–2 years of experience** 
  in graphic design, or you're a fresher with a killer portfolio.
* You know your way around 
 **Photoshop \& Illustrator** 
 .
* Bonus points if you know After Effects / Premiere Pro.
* You understand typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.
* You can make things look good 
 **without making them unnecessarily complicated** 
 .
* You have an eye for detail. Yes, that means noticing when things are 2 pixels off.
* You can handle multiple briefs without your laptop becoming a crime scene.
* You’re curious, proactive and actually want to get better at what you do.



  





**Extra points if...You:** 



* Know the difference between 
 **good design and design that just has a lot going on** 
 .
* Have strong opinions about fonts.
* Follow interesting brands instead of just design pages.
* Can explain 
 *why* 
  something works, not just that it "looks cool".
* Have a portfolio that makes us stop scrolling.
* Occasionally see an ad and think, 
 **"I could've made that better."**



  





**What Shizz is like** 




 You won't be sitting around making the same banner 47 times a day.
 



 You'll work across 
 **different brands, industries, briefs and creative challenges** 
 , and you'll get to see your work actually go out into the world.
 



 You'll work with strategists, copywriters, creatives and marketers. So you'll learn much more than just design.
 



  





**If you are a person who can get Shizz done, we would love to hear from you.**

title: UI UX Designer
description:
We are looking out for folks who are deeply passionate about working with tech Startups. If you live and breathe UX, this role is for you. As an
 **Senior UI UX Designer** 
 at Tech Exactly, you will get opportunities to work on great products (Mobile Apps \& Web Apps) from some of the smartest founders from around the world.
 



  





 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐨 \-
 


* Interact with prospects and understand their business goals.
* Research \& Create user personas, user journey, and information architecture to lay foundation for top notch product experience.
* You would also have to present your research to the client.
* Create a low \& high fidelity wireframe during the pre\-sales and post\-sales phase to help clients understand the user journey.
* You would be required to guide the development team about the user journey.
* You will also be expected to design high quality user interfaces and get those approved from clients.
* You will also be expected to ensure the development team has all the design assets as and when they need it.
* You’d have to ensure the design handoff to the development team is smooth and there are no gaps in the handoff.
* You’ll have to closely review the development builds and provide feedback to ensure your UX/UI recommendations are adhered to.



  





 𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 \-
 


* Excellent English communication skills both written and spoken is a must for this role.
* Should have very strong analytical skills.
* Should be confident, organized, humble, patient, soft spoken, quick learner and most importantly driven to excel.
* Should have 4\+ experience doing UX/UI for Mobile App Development projects.
* Should understand Human interface guidelines.
* Should have basic knowledge on the app development process.
* Ability to come up with new concepts and help clients innovate is a big value add.
* Should have solid hands on experience with Figma.
* Should have design thinking.
* Knowledge in scrum will make your application stronger.
